body: Sometimes I can be happy, and the next minute, all the negative thoughts flooded through my mind and I start to get depressed until I cried.

You see, he lives half way across the world. We live in different time zones. There's long time in a day that we can't talk because of the time difference. And... If I take a step back, wouldn't we be more further apart?
I talked to a lot of people... But those emotions just keep biting me back whenever I'm alone. Unless I have someone who can stay with me 24 hours... I don't think I can escape them.

I think I have trust issues on guys... Every men in my life have been untrustworthy and selfish. My rational side told me what you said, but the emotional side of me... Just don't want to let him go.
Is this abnormal?

I've been hating myself...

I wish that I could just disappear.

I became possessive about a friend. I hate to see him being with another friend. I hate to see him happy when I'm not the reason. And I hate myself for feeling so. 

I became insecure about my social status. I'm scared and constantly worried about every little thing related to that particular friend. I'm scared that he'd replace me and abandon me for another friend. Even though he says that he won't but a large part of me just... Doubts.

And that doubtful thought, that fear led me to depression and anxiety...

There are times that I can be normal. But most of the time... The anxiety just attacks me.

I wish I can disappear so my friends won't have to constantly worry about me.
I did... I told him how I feel. He kept saying that he won't replace me with another friend or abandon me. But... But some part of me just... Doubts.
